debts.title: Immutable ontology versus mutable worldstate wording
debts.description: Current surfaces use static-world language alongside lawful worldstate and location mutation contracts; M1 must distinguish immutable ontology from mutable scoped state.
debts.resolution_criteria: One canonical distinction between immutable ontology and mutable scoped worldstate is adopted and all normative references agree.

debts.title: Realm and plane coordinate terminology
debts.description: Realm, plane, coordinate, bit position, ordinal, and presentation-order language is not yet normalized into one canonical model.

source_refs.locator: 1. Cosmology Deep Dive > The Nine Realms

debts.resolution_criteria: M1 defines each term, migrates conflicting normative usage, and supplies durable rationale.

debts.title: Symbolic grammar ownership and ASH dependency identity
debts.description: The repository has corrected top-level authority references, but the exact symbolic-grammar owner and pinned ASH dependency identity remain M1 work.
debts.resolution_criteria: M1 records one authoritative symbolic-grammar owner and one pinned ASH dependency identity.

debts.title: Companion resonance and alignment aliases
debts.description: Historical wolf_alignment fields coexist with preferred wolf_resonance and dual-variable terminology.
debts.resolution_criteria: M1 defines the canonical term and explicit migration aliases without changing Twin Wolf canon.

debts.title: Append-only history versus reversible effects
debts.description: Append-only history requirements coexist with lawful reversals expressed as new state deltas; their semantic boundary needs one normative statement.
debts.resolution_criteria: M1 distinguishes immutable event history from reversible current-state effects and updates all normative terms.

debts.title: YWE Core and WRW content separation
debts.description: WRW reference material appears beside YWE Core contracts and needs complete normative scope separation.
debts.resolution_criteria: Every normative YWE Core artifact and WRW reference-profile artifact has an unambiguous scope and no WRW-specific rule becomes universal core truth.

debts.title: Duplicated ASH specification mirrors
debts.description: The specs tree and core/ash_pattern_engine/canonical tree each contain 32 files; 31 matching relative paths are byte-identical, while each tree has one unique file.
debts.resolution_criteria: M1 declares one authoritative source or generated-mirror relationship and validates synchronization deterministically.

debts.title: Phase 13, 15, 16, and 17 evidence completion
debts.description: Historical foundations and recovery-origin labels exist, but M6 requires complete durable acceptance evidence and neutral scenario coverage.
debts.resolution_criteria: M6 acceptance proves Phases 13, 15, 16, and 17 with durable evidence and passes the same contracts for Ravenfall and a neutral scenario.

debts.title: Historical release-worded commit subjects
debts.description: Immutable Git history contains 23 commit subjects named Release v2.0.1 through Release v2.0.23; current policy classifies them as repository baseline history, not specification publication.
debts.resolution_criteria: Retain immutable history while current publication authorities consistently state that the specification is unreleased.
debts.accepted_exception_rationale: Rewriting published Git history would be destructive; the exception is limited to immutable subjects and cannot excuse an active release claim.

debts.title: Source inventory semantics and counts
debts.description: Legacy source-ingest lists were presented as current placeholder maturity and disagreed with actual artifact states and repository-wide counts.
debts.resolution_criteria: All three inventories identify the machine classification authority, expose truthful counts, and preserve legacy lists only as provenance.

debts.title: Platform branch policy conflict
debts.description: Public contribution surfaces previously treated non-main branches as platform implementation work despite the closed M10 platform gate.
debts.resolution_criteria: Every branch in this repository remains platform-neutral and platform implementation is limited to separate downstream repositories after M10.

debts.title: Exact-one artifact classification missing
debts.description: The audited baseline lacked a complete machine-readable exact-one maturity and scope classification for all tracked paths.
debts.resolution_criteria: The classification and scope manifests cover every tracked path exactly once and their validator passes.

debts.title: Public promise register missing
debts.description: The audited baseline had no complete register assigning every active public product promise to a milestone or formal exclusion.
debts.resolution_criteria: The promise register has 33 reviewed semantic records, no unresolved disposition, and hash coverage for all reviewed public surfaces.

debts.title: Repository-wide quality debt not consolidated
debts.description: The audited baseline ratcheted schema debt but did not consolidate placeholders, roadmap open work, semantic debt, historical exceptions, and M0 findings.
debts.resolution_criteria: The general debt inventory contains every required source, exact-set digests, owners, milestones, and resolution criteria.

debts.title: Publication and baseline semantics ambiguous
debts.description: Historical tags and release-worded records required an explicit policy separating baseline maintenance from specification and product publication.
debts.resolution_criteria: Machine and human publication policies identify VERSION as baseline authority, keep publication unreleased, and gate publication and downstream products through M10.

debts.title: Legal owner and recognized alias not documented
debts.description: Active ownership surfaces use James Daley and Jim Daley without a canonical repository-local alias rule or commercial licensing email.
debts.resolution_criteria: Repository truth identifies James Daley as legal owner, rightsholder, and licensor; Jim Daley as the same person's recognized alias; and the commercial licensing contact without changing security reporting.

debts.title: M0 acceptance evidence absent
debts.description: The audited roadmap has an empty M0 acceptance_evidence array and cannot transition without real command and diff evidence.
debts.resolution_criteria: Machine-readable and human-readable M0 acceptance evidence contain actual passing results and the roadmap references them before transition.

debts.title: Active references to superseded authority
debts.description: Active flow, master specification, README, and historical flow notes previously treated a superseded ASH Pattern System authority contract as current.
debts.resolution_criteria: All active references name the cosmological-model and component contracts as current and retain the former contract only as superseded packet-spine evidence.

debts.title: Broken repository-local path references
debts.description: Two active documentation surfaces referenced repository paths that did not exist.
debts.resolution_criteria: Every corrected local reference resolves to the intended current repository authority.
